name: Mt. Washington
description: Relish in the authentic West Coast vibe, where the clock ticks a little slower. Island time radiates throughout the happy, laid-back Mt. Washington locals who prosper in the bounty of fresh local fair, beautiful climate, and an endless coastal playground, year-round. The true seasonal magic you're looking for is all right here. Mount Washington Alpine Resort has been a must-visit destination for Vancouver Island snow sports enthusiasts for over 45 years.
